items.title: File lawsuit (Klage) against rejection of Sondernutzungserlaubnis
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: The one-month Klage period under §74 VwGO runs from the day the Bescheid is 'bekanntgegeben' (notified) to the recipient. The letter itself carries no issue/dispatch date, so the start of the period cannot be fixed. If it had been sent by ordinary domestic mail, §41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW would deem it delivered on the third day after mailing (unless the recipient disputes this), and the one-month period would then be counted per §§187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (ending on the same-numbered day of the following month, or the next day if that month has no such date), shifted to the next working day if it fell on a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday per §193 BGB. Since no document date (and hence no dispatch/Bekanntgabe date) is printed anywhere on the letter, none of these steps can actually be anchored to a real date, so the exact deadline cannot be computed from the text alone.

warnings: The letter shows no issue/dispatch date (only the applicant's request date of 02.07.2026), so the statutory Bekanntgabe (notification) date that starts the one-month Klage period under §74 VwGO cannot be determined; check the envelope postmark or any date stamp on the original document to fix the exact deadline.

No 'Vorverfahren' (Widerspruch) is required here because the letter states 'ein Vorverfahren entfällt' — the only remedy is direct Klage to the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt within one month of notification.
